title: Japanese Beef Dumplings
description: A traditional Japanese dish featuring pan-fried beef dumplings served with a tangy dipping sauce. This recipe showcases the flavors of Japan with the comfort of homemade dumplings.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine Slovakian beef, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Mix well.
Lay dumpling wrappers on a flat surface. Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edge of the wrapper. Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add the dumplings and cook until the bottoms are golden brown.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and cover with a lid. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, prepare the dipping sauce by mixing soy sauce and acidic ingredient in a small bowl.
Once the dumplings are cooked, remove them from the skillet and serve with the dipping sauce.
Garnish with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of sesame seeds, if desired.
